description: 1-minute OHLCV bars for SPY and QQQ (ETF proxies for ES/NQ cash-index flow) intended as ex-ante predictors for intraday NQ strategies. Main files contain only consolidated-tape (SIP-quality) bars; two clearly-labelled lower-quality supplements cover part of October 2026. Built only from public GitHub repositories reachable from the research container; nothing was fabricated, forward-filled or interpolated.

spy_1m.parquet.desc: MAIN SPY 1-minute bars, NYSE sessions 2019-12-02..2026-09-30, 04:00-20:00 ET where available (RTH only after 2026-04-09). Spliced per (session date, segment) from consolidated-tape sources; see splice_decisions.

qqq_1m.parquet.desc: MAIN QQQ 1-minute bars, NYSE sessions 2020-07-13..2026-09-30, 04:00-20:00 ET where available (RTH only after 2026-08-21). All rows are Alpaca SIP (consolidated tape) bars from three byte-identical mirrors.

spy_1m_supplement.parquet.desc: LOWER-QUALITY SUPPLEMENT, kept out of the main file: SPY RTH 1-minute bars 2026-10-08..2026-10-23 from Alpaca IEX feed (IEX exchange only, ~2% of consolidated volume). Not verified against SIP (no overlap available).

qqq_1m_supplement.parquet.desc: LOWER-QUALITY SUPPLEMENT, kept out of the main file: QQQ 1-minute bars built from Dukascopy QQQ.US/USD CFD bid/ask MID quotes (not trades), 7 sessions in 2026-10 only, 09:30-14:59 ET only. Volume column is Dukascopy quote volume, not shares.

timezone: ts_utc is a timezone-aware UTC timestamp (parquet timestamp[ns, tz=UTC]) marking the START of the bar: the bar covers trades in [ts_utc, ts_utc+60s). Session logic should convert to America/New_York (RTH 09:30-16:00 ET, 13:00 ET close on early-close days; extended 04:00-09:30 and close-20:00 ET). Every source was verified to stamp bars at minute start (09:30 ET bar carries the opening-auction volume spike) and converted to UTC with DST-aware zoneinfo.

columns.open: float64 USD, first eligible trade price in the minute; raw/unadjusted (no SPY or QQQ splits in window; prices are NOT dividend-adjusted)
columns.high: float64 USD, highest eligible trade price in the minute
columns.low: float64 USD, lowest eligible trade price in the minute
columns.close: float64 USD, last eligible trade price in the minute
columns.volume: int64 shares traded in the minute (main files: consolidated tape; definition differs slightly by source, see known_issues; supplements: IEX-only shares for SPY, Dukascopy quote volume units for QQQ, stored as float64 in qqq_1m_supplement.parquet)

splice_decisions.rule: For every XNYS session date and each segment (pre 04:00-09:30, rth 09:30-close, post close-20:00 ET) exactly ONE source is used: the highest-priority source that has at least one bar in that (date, segment). Sources are never mixed inside a segment, so condition-filtering conventions never change mid-segment; missing minutes are NOT filled from lower-priority sources.
splice_decisions.QQQ_agreement_basis: All three QQQ sources are mirrors of the same Alpaca SIP bars and agree exactly (100.000% OHLC within 1 cent, identical volume, zero RTH minutes missing in one but present in another apart from early-close days that close-reversal drops by design): oyzh888 vs rtharb on 188,635 minutes (2024-08-22..2025-07-09, all hours); oyzh888 vs close-reversal on 243,360 RTH minutes; rtharb vs close-reversal on 193,440 RTH minutes. QQQ was therefore spliced only where sources agree; no QQQ source that disagreed (lvrusu, Dukascopy mid-quotes) was put in the main file.
splice_decisions.SPY_agreement_basis: Alpaca mirrors identical (oyzh888 vs close-reversal: 243,356 RTH minutes, 100%). prsdro/spy vs Alpaca SIP: RTH close within 1 cent on 99.78-100% of minutes per year 2020-2025; extended hours 99.99% (2020-2022) but only 45-79% (2023-2025) because prsdro OHLC includes odd-lot/non-last-sale-eligible prints (identical volume, different prices). prsdro is therefore used only where no SIP source exists.

known_issues: QQQ: no 1-minute data at all for 2019-12-02..2020-07-10 (153 sessions incl. the Feb-Apr 2020 crash). Extensive searching of GitHub repos/code (QQQ 1min/minute/1Min/full_1min/QQQUSUSD filenames, Zarattini/ORB replications, Alpaca/Polygon/FirstRate/Dukascopy mirrors, recently pushed SPY/QQQ repos) and web search found no public 1m QQQ source for that window on allowed hosts. Kaggle/HuggingFace/Zenodo/FirstRate/Dukascopy/Polygon direct downloads are blocked.

October 2026: neither symbol has SIP-quality data after 2026-09-30. Supplements: SPY IEX-only RTH bars for 12 sessions 2026-10-08..2026-10-23 (2026-10-01..10-07 missing entirely); QQQ Dukascopy CFD mid-quote bars for 7 sessions (10-01, 10-14, 10-15, 10-16, 10-20, 10-21, 10-23), 09:30-14:59 ET only.

Extended hours end earlier than RTH: SPY pre/post-market only through 2026-04-09; QQQ pre/post-market only through 2026-08-21. After that the main files are RTH-only (09:30-15:59, no 16:00 closing-auction bar).

Volume definition is not homogeneous for SPY: prsdro-era bars (2019-12-02..2020-07-10) have about 0.82x the Alpaca SIP volume (vendor appears to exclude odd lots/some conditions), so SPY volume features have a level break at 2020-07-13. From 2023 prsdro volume equals SIP volume minute-for-minute, but its extended-hours OHLC includes odd-lot/ineligible prints: used only for SPY pre/post-market 2025-07-10..2026-04-09 where 340 of 102,132 bars have a wick >0.5% beyond the body (e.g. isolated bad prints); consider wick clipping or using close only for those rows (source == prsdro/spy and ts after 2025-07-10).
QQQ main volume is Alpaca SIP throughout (FirstRate shows ~0.86x of it), so QQQ has no volume-definition break.

prsdro/spy vendor for bars before 2025-10-22 is undocumented in that repo; its prices agree with Alpaca SIP (RTH close within 1 cent on >=99.78% of minutes per year) and with SIP 30-min bars in the window where it is used. fetch_massive.py (Massive bars 2025-10-22+) uses an approximate DST switch at 02:00 UTC on transition Sundays, which cannot affect weekday bars; the per-month spike check confirms 2026-03/2025-11 alignment.

Missing minutes are left missing (no forward fill): minutes without eligible trades have no row, frequent in early pre-market and late post-market. RTH sessions below 99% of expected minutes: SPY 2020-03-09/12/16/18 (376 bars: genuine 15-min market-wide circuit-breaker halts), SPY 2021-05-05 (385) and 2023-06-05 (386; 09:52-09:55 ET absent in Alpaca but present in prsdro, deliberately not filled). QQQ: none.

close-reversal (RTH source) omits early-close sessions by design; on SPY 2025-11-28 and 2025-12-24 the RTH segment therefore comes from prsdro/spy. QQQ early-close days in the rtharb window come from Alpaca SIP all-hours data.

Prices are raw (not dividend-adjusted). SPY and QQQ pay quarterly dividends, so multi-day return features spanning ex-dates carry small artificial gaps (~0.3-0.6% SPY, ~0.15% QQQ). No splits occurred in the window.
Bars stamped at or after 20:00 ET or before 04:00 ET were dropped (615 prsdro rows, mostly 20:00 late prints; 23 oyzh888 SPY rows). No rows fell on non-session dates.

The official closing price is the closing-auction print, which appears inside the 16:00 ET (13:00 on early closes) bar for all-hours sources; the 15:59 bar close can differ from the official close (by >$1 on volatile days such as 2025-04-09). RTH-only segments (close-reversal) contain no closing-auction bar.

SPY supplement (IEX): IEX-only volume (~2% of consolidated), highs/lows can differ from the consolidated tape, usually no 15:59 bar (the bot snapshot ran before the close), 2026-10-15 has 315 bars; it could not be checked against SIP because no SIP minute data overlaps it.

QQQ supplement (Dukascopy): quotes of a CFD on QQQ, mid of bid/ask, not exchange trades; only days chosen by that repo's own gap filter; volume column is Dukascopy quote volume (not shares) and must not be compared with main-file volume.
ts_utc uses nanosecond precision with tz=UTC; readers that drop timezone info will see UTC wall-clock times, not ET.
